name: Dribba Public API
description:
Public HTTP surface of dribba.com, the site of Dribba — an end-to-end digital product studio in Barcelona and Andorra (Flutter, Go backends, AI integration).

**Authentication:** none. Every `/api/v1` operation is public and read-only.
**Errors:** RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code` and a `resolution` hint.
**Rate limit:** 120 requests per 60s per client IP, advertised through the IETF `RateLimit` fields on every response.
**Versioning:** major version in the path (`/api/v1`). Additive changes land inside v1; breaking changes get a new major path, announced with RFC 9745 `Deprecation`/`Sunset` headers at least 90 days ahead.

The legacy form endpoints (`/api/contact`, `/api/apply`…) enforce same-origin and are documented for completeness. For agent-initiated writes use the remote MCP server at https://dribba.com/mcp.

Other machine surfaces: OKF bundle at https://dribba.com/okf, `Accept: text/markdown` on any page URL (or append `.md`: https://dribba.com/index.md), https://dribba.com/llms.txt.
Conventions answered explicitly, including the ones that do not apply: authentication (https://dribba.com/auth.md), pricing (https://dribba.com/pricing.md), pagination, idempotency, async jobs and batching — see the `x-api-conventions` extension below.
